pages.text: 早上起床，咘咘坐在床边发呆。她想起昨天午睡时睡不着，还哭了鼻子……「今天会不会又睡不着呀？」
pages.text_en: Bubu sits on the edge of her bed in the morning, lost in thought. She remembers how she couldn't fall asleep during naptime yesterday and even cried... "What if I can't sleep again today?"

pages.text: NOMI 走过来，蹲在咘咘面前笑着说：「昨天老师说一步一步来，今天就是新的一步呀！」Coco 跳到床头：「You got this, Bubu!」
pages.text_en: NOMI walks over and kneels in front of Bubu with a smile: "The teacher said to take it one step at a time — today is your next step!" Coco hops onto the headboard: "You got this, Bubu!"

pages.text: 到了幼儿园门口，咘咘今天没有紧张！她主动挥手：「老师早上好！」猫咪老师笑眯眯地摸摸她的头：「咘咘早上好呀，今天精神真好！」
pages.text_en: At the school gate, Bubu isn't nervous today! She waves cheerfully: "Good morning, Teacher!" The cat teacher smiles and pats her head: "Good morning, Bubu! You look great today!"

pages.text: 教室里，咘咘和昨天认识的新朋友一起画画。她画了一个大太阳和一只小兔子，开心地举起来给大家看。
pages.text_en: In the classroom, Bubu draws with the new friends she made yesterday. She paints a big sun and a little bunny, happily holding it up for everyone to see.

pages.text: 午饭时间，咘咘吃得又快又好！旁边的小朋友勺子掉了，咘咘还主动帮忙递了一把新的。猫咪老师在远处点点头微笑。
pages.text_en: At lunchtime, Bubu eats well and quickly! When the kid next to her drops a spoon, Bubu hands over a new one. The cat teacher nods and smiles from across the room.

pages.text: 「小朋友们，午睡时间到啦——」老师温柔地拍拍手。咘咘的心突然咚咚跳起来，她想起昨天……
pages.text_en: "Everyone, it's naptime!" The teacher gently claps her hands. Bubu's heart starts pounding — she remembers yesterday...

pages.text: 猫咪老师走到咘咘的小床边，轻轻地说：「咘咘，今天试试闭上眼睛，想一件开心的事好不好？」
pages.text_en: The cat teacher walks to Bubu's little bed and whispers softly: "Bubu, try closing your eyes today and think of something happy, okay?"

pages.text: 咘咘闭上眼睛。她想到了早上 NOMI 说的「新的一步」，想到了 Coco 说的「You got this」，想到了爸爸妈妈的笑脸……慢慢地，慢慢地……她真的睡着了。
pages.text_en: Bubu closes her eyes. She thinks of NOMI saying "your next step," Coco saying "You got this," and Mom and Dad's smiling faces... slowly, slowly... she actually falls asleep.

pages.text: 「咘咘，起床啦——」咘咘睁开眼睛，揉了揉脸。等等……我真的睡着了！我睡了午觉！她一下子坐起来，眼睛亮亮的。
pages.text_en: "Bubu, time to wake up!" Bubu opens her eyes and rubs her face. Wait... I actually fell asleep! I took a nap! She sits up with sparkling eyes.

pages.text: 猫咪老师笑着走过来，手里拿着一颗闪闪发光的金色星星贴纸。她把贴纸轻轻贴在咘咘胸前：「咘咘今天好棒！这是你的第一个棒棒贴！」
pages.text_en: The cat teacher comes over with a sparkling gold star sticker in her hand. She gently places it on Bubu's chest: "Bubu, you were amazing today! This is your very first gold star!"

pages.text: 放学了！咘咘飞奔出来，扑进爸爸妈妈的怀里，骄傲地指着胸前的金星星：「我今天睡午觉了！老师给我贴了棒棒贴！」爸爸把她举高高：「我们咘咘太厉害了！」
pages.text_en: School's out! Bubu runs into Mom and Dad's arms, proudly pointing at the gold star on her chest: "I took a nap today! The teacher gave me a gold star!" Dad lifts her high: "Our Bubu is amazing!"

pages.text: 回家路上，咘咘一直低头看着胸前的棒棒贴，笑得合不拢嘴。Coco 在旁边开心地说：「I'm so proud of you, Bubu! You did it!」NOMI 竖起大拇指，NONO 在头顶飞来飞去唱歌。
pages.text_en: On the way home, Bubu keeps looking down at the gold star on her chest, grinning from ear to ear. Coco says happily: "I'm so proud of you, Bubu! You did it!" NOMI gives a thumbs up, and NONO flies overhead singing.
